context.description: 生成英文词频统计组件，严格使用 execute(payload) -> dict。输入为 {"text": 字符串}，输出仅为 {"frequencies": [{"word": 字符串, "count": 正整数}]}。单词严格指连续 ASCII 英文字母 [A-Za-z]+，统一小写；数字、中文、撇号、连字符、下划线和其他非 ASCII 字母字符均作为分隔符。先按次数降序排列，同频按小写单词字母顺序排列。空文本或没有英文单词时返回空 frequencies 列表，不修改输入。只使用允许的纯 Python 标准库，不需要训练、分类或检索。

behaviors: Implement check_fields(payload). payload has records [{record_id, fields}] and required_fields [str]. Field names are literal top-level keys, including dots; never split a dotted name into a path.

A required value is missing only if its key is absent, its value is None, a string whose strip() is empty, or an empty list or dict. Numeric zero and boolean False are present. Nonempty lists/dicts are present without recursively checking their contents. Do not treat every falsy value as missing.

Return {records: [{record_id, missing_fields, complete}], complete}. Preserve record order and required_fields order in missing_fields. Each record complete iff no missing fields; overall complete iff all records complete. Empty records yields records=[] and complete=True; no required fields makes every record complete. Never mutate inputs. Return only these exact keys.

Implement check_references(payload). payload.sources is [{source_id, segments:[{segment_id,text}]}]. payload.fields is [{field_id,references:[{source_id,segment_id,start,end,quote}]}]. Source IDs and field IDs are unique; segment IDs are unique only WITHIN each source. Resolve segment within its cited source, not globally.

For EACH reference preserve its zero-based index and choose status in strict precedence: source_missing if source ID absent; else segment_missing if segment ID absent within that source; else invalid_range unless 0 <= start < end <= len(text); else quote_mismatch unless text[start:end] == quote exactly; else valid. Offsets use Python Unicode character indexes, end-exclusive, not UTF-8 bytes. Do not strip, casefold, normalize or search for a quote elsewhere.

Return {fields:[{field_id,status,references:[{index,status}]}], valid}. Preserve field/reference order and multiplicity. Field status missing_reference for empty references, otherwise valid iff ALL its references are valid, else invalid_reference. Overall valid iff ALL fields valid; empty fields gives fields=[] and valid=True. Return only exact keys and never mutate inputs.
This checks citation locations and exact quotations, NOT whether a claim is semantically supported or factually true. A valid quote does not establish semantic truth.
Return ranked unique input IDs with finite nonnegative scores.

English alphanumeric/underscore identifiers are whole lowercase words; Chinese uses characters and adjacent bigrams strictly within each contiguous Chinese run; never concatenate across spaces, punctuation or English.
Empty query, memories or nonpositive top_k returns []. Never mutate inputs.
Return one effective-training label per text, preserving order and multiplicity.
Fit on training only. Do not mutate inputs. Handle blank, empty and single-label cases.
